newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept export tax rebates up 31 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept export tax rebates up 31 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's export tax rebates totalled 57.39 billion yuan ($6.9 billion) in January to September, up 31.5 percent from the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

The amount was 88.3 percent of the budgeted amount for tax rebates to Chinese companies engaging in foreign trade despite a decrease in exports during the period, Xinhua quoted the State General Administration of Taxation as saying.
Beijing has been speeding up payment of tax rebates to encourage exports.
Exports totalled $104 billion in the first nine months of the year, down 2.7 percent from the same period in 1995, the agency said, quoting previously announced data.
China's tax revenue during the first nine months was up 21.1 percent, or 78 billion yuan, compared with the year-ago period, it said.
